Sam Harper: Quick sync  customers reporting leads briefly unassigned before RR picks up. want to prove where delay is (HS webhook vs enrichment vs assignment).
Lina Ortiz: can we add a tiny probe that emits hashed_lead + recv_ts + enrich_done_ts + assign_ts + owner_type + fallback_flag? sample 5% to start.
Marco Velez: yes. Also include connector=hubspot|salesforce and tenant_region. keep no PII, salt+hash lead ids.
Priya Nair: legal ok if salted and no raw email/phone. add consent_flag and opt-out via metadata.probe=false.
Sam Harper: plan: events -> kafka topic inbound.handoff.probes -> consumer -> Prom metrics + Console card. histogram for enrich_latency and p95 assign.
Lina Ortiz: alerts: inbound.assign.latency.p95 > 180s -> page ops. fallback_rate > 1% sustained 10m -> ops alert.
Marco Velez: rollout: internal full-sample 24h -> 5% prod 72h -> 25% 7d -> aggregate-only. canary: if canary p95 > 3m disable sampling.
Priya Nair: add per-connector heatmap (HS vs SF) and a rr_fairness_skew sample. if skew > 3x expected, auto-schedule replay.
HSWebhookBot: webhook received portal=812 at 1758881302 (evt hb_812_a9)
Sam Harper: next steps: Marco build consumer PR, Lina add dashboard ticket MKT-6230, Priya will approve compliance on PR.
Lina Ortiz: ticket created MKT-6230 "Handoff telemetry probe + connector split dashboard". assigning @Marco and @Priya.
Marco Velez: PR target EOD Thu, staging run Fri, prod canary Mon. I'll include unit tests for salting+hashing.
Sam Harper: thanks all. after staging run we'll decide exact SLO thresholds and whether to enable recovery backfill for recent default-owner fallbacks.
Lina Ortiz: :thumbsup: closing thread, will post updates in ticket.
